question: How many films are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film

question: How many actors are in the database?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM actor

question: List the names of all film categories.
sql: SELECT name FROM category

question: How many films are rated PG-13?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

question: What is the average film length in minutes?
sql: SELECT avg(length) FROM film

question: Which films are longer than 180 minutes?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE length > 180

question: How many films have a rental rate of 4.99?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rental_rate = 4.99

question: What is the total amount of all payments?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment

question: How many rentals have not been returned yet?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: What are the first and last names of the staff members?
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM staff

question: How many countries are in the database?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM country

question: What is the highest replacement cost of any film?
sql: SELECT max(replacement_cost) FROM film

question: What is the email address of the customer Mary Smith?
sql: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE first_name = 'MARY' AND last_name = 'SMITH'

question: How many films are shorter than 60 minutes?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE length < 60

question: What is the smallest payment amount?
sql: SELECT min(amount) FROM payment

question: How many films are in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many customers does each store have?
sql: SELECT store_id, count(*) FROM customer GROUP BY store_id

question: How many films are there for each rating?
sql: SELECT rating, count(*) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: Which actors appear in the film Academy Dinosaur?
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: How many films has the actor Nick Wahlberg appeared in?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'NICK' AND a.last_name = 'WAHLBERG'

question: List the titles of all films in the Horror category.
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: How many customers live in Canada?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: What is the average rental rate for each rating?
sql: SELECT rating, avg(rental_rate) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: How many rentals did each staff member process?
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, count(*) FROM staff s JOIN rental r ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

question: Which countries have more than 30 customers?
sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country HAVING count(*) > 30

question: How many copies of Academy Dinosaur are in the inventory?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: What is the average length of films in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name, avg(f.length) FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many payments were made in March 2022?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2022-03-01' AND payment_date < '2022-04-01'

question: What is the total payment amount collected by each staff member?
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, sum(p.amount) FROM staff s JOIN payment p ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

question: Which customers live in London?
sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id WHERE ci.city = 'London'

question: How many films are in the Action category?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Action'

question: How much has the customer Eleanor Hunt paid in total?
sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE c.first_name = 'ELEANOR' AND c.last_name = 'HUNT'

question: How many different films have been rented at least once?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.film_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id

question: How many inventory copies does store 2 hold?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM inventory WHERE store_id = 2

question: Which films rated G are longer than 170 minutes?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'G' AND length > 170

question: What are the top 3 film categories by total payment revenue?
sql: SELECT c.name, sum(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actor has appeared in the most films?
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which two customers have rented the most films?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 2

question: Which customers have paid more than $200 in total?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING sum(p.amount) > 200

question: Which films have never been rented?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: What are the two most rented films?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 2

question: What is the total payment revenue from films rated R?
sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.rating = 'R'

question: How many customers have never rented a film?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id)

question: Which Comedy films have a rental rate of 0.99?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy' AND f.rental_rate = 0.99

question: For each store, how many rentals were made from its inventory?
sql: SELECT i.store_id, count(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id

question: Which three customers have paid the most in total?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 3

question: On average, how much has each customer paid in total?
sql: SELECT avg(total) FROM (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: Which categories have more than 70 films?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING count(*) > 70

question: Which films rated R has the actor Gina Degeneres appeared in?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'GINA' AND a.last_name = 'DEGENERES' AND f.rating = 'R'

question: What was the total payment amount in each month of 2022?
sql: SELECT extract(month FROM payment_date) AS month, sum(amount) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2022-01-01' AND payment_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS customer_count FROM customer

question: How many films are rated R?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rating = 'R'

question: List the names of all languages.
sql: SELECT name FROM language

question: What is the average rental rate of all films?
sql: SELECT avg(rental_rate) AS average_rental_rate FROM film

question: Which films are shorter than 50 minutes?
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE length < 50

question: What is the largest single payment amount?
sql: SELECT max(amount) AS largest_payment FROM payment

question: How many cities are there in each country?
sql: SELECT co.country, count(*) AS city_count FROM country co JOIN city ci ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country

question: How many films has the actor Penelope Guiness appeared in?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name ILIKE 'penelope' AND a.last_name ILIKE 'guiness'

question: List the titles of all films in the Comedy category.
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name ILIKE 'comedy'

question: How many customers live in India?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS customer_count FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country ILIKE 'india'

question: Which actors appear in the film African Egg?
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id WHERE f.title ILIKE 'african egg'

question: How much has the customer Mary Smith paid in total?
sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE c.first_name ILIKE 'mary' AND c.last_name ILIKE 'smith'

question: How many copies of African Egg are in the inventory?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS copy_count FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.title ILIKE 'african egg'

question: How many rentals were made in May 2022?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS rental_count FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2022-05-01' AND rental_date < '2022-06-01'

question: Which countries have more than 50 customers?
sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country HAVING count(*) > 50

question: How many films are there in each language?
sql: SELECT l.name, count(*) AS film_count FROM film f JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id GROUP BY l.name

question: What is the average replacement cost of films in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name, avg(f.replacement_cost) AS average_replacement_cost FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Which customers live in the city of Aurora?
sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id WHERE ci.city ILIKE 'aurora'

question: What are the top 3 film categories by number of rentals?
sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which customer has made the most payments?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, count(*) AS payment_count FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which films have no copies in the inventory?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: What is the total payment revenue from films rated PG?
sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.rating = 'PG'

question: Which staff member processed the most rentals?
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, count(*) AS rental_count FROM staff s JOIN rental r ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many payments has each customer made?
sql: SELECT avg(payment_count) AS average_payments FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS payment_count FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: How many rentals were made in each month of 2022?
sql: SELECT extract(month FROM rental_date) AS month, count(*) AS rental_count FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2022-01-01' AND rental_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
